text.A: **Ova politika se primenjuje gde god da se nalazite.** Pridržavamo se propisa Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva o zaštiti podataka, a kada se primenjuju i propisi o zaštiti podataka zemlje u kojoj živite, pridržavamo se i njih.
text.B: **Napomene o alergijama i ishrani.** Prosleđujemo ih food trucku zajedno sa vašom porudžbinom i ne koristimo ih ni za šta drugo. Uklanjamo ih, zajedno sa vašim imenom i kontakt podacima, 12 meseci nakon porudžbine (pogledajte odeljak 7).
text.C: **Međunarodni prenos.** Podaci o vašem nalogu i podaci o porudžbinama čuvaju se i obrađuju u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu. Neke radnje se obavljaju van njega: izdvajanje sadržaja menija i automatski odgovori na WhatsApp-u, za koje se koristi Google-ova usluga u Sjedinjenim Američkim Državama; dostava WhatsApp poruka, koju obavlja Meta u Sjedinjenim Američkim Državama; plaćanja, koja obavlja Stripe u Sjedinjenim Američkim Državama; i push obaveštenja, koja dostavljaju Apple i Google u Sjedinjenim Američkim Državama. Kada podaci napuštaju Ujedinjeno Kraljevstvo, prenos je obuhvaćen propisima Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva o adekvatnosti (UK adequacy regulations) ili Međunarodnim ugovorom o prenosu podataka (International Data Transfer Agreement) ili Dodatkom (Addendum), a kada to zahteva pravo vaše zemlje, i merom zaštite koju to pravo priznaje. Možete nas zamoliti za pojedinosti o merama zaštite koje se primenjuju.
text.G:
Naši [Uslovi korišćenja](/terms) primenjuju se u svakoj zemlji u kojoj se HatchGrab koristi. U nekim zemljama važe dodatna pravila. Na ovoj stranici ona su navedena, zemlju po zemlju.

Kada se neki od odeljaka u nastavku odnosi na vas, on čini sastavni deo naših Uslova korišćenja. Ako je u njemu navedeno nešto drugačije nego u njima, za tu zemlju merodavna je ova stranica.

Ako vaša zemlja nije navedena, dodatna pravila ne postoje: Uslovi korišćenja primenjuju se onako kako su napisani. Naša [Politika privatnosti](/privacy) ista je u svakoj zemlji.

back.A: **This policy applies wherever you are.** We comply with UK data protection regulations, and when the data protection regulations of the country you live in also apply, we comply with those too.
back.B: **Notes on allergies and diet.** We forward them to the food truck together with your order and do not use them for anything else. We remove them, together with your name and contact details, 12 months after the order (see section 7).
back.C: ...or by the Addendum (Addendum), and when the law of your country requires it, also by a protection measure [safeguard] that this law recognises.
back.D: Intro: Under UK data protection regulations and the law of the country you live in, when it applies, you have the right to: [bullets unchanged]. / The law of the country you live in may give you these rights under other names or give you additional rights. You have those rights too. / **Submitting a request.** Write to privacy@hatchgrab.com. Before we act on a request, we will check whether it is genuine. You can authorise another person to submit the request on your behalf, and we will not treat you differently because you submitted a request. We will reply within one month or earlier if the law of your country requires it. If you ordered from a food truck, we may forward your request to that food truck, because it decides how your order details are used. If we refuse a request, you can ask us to reconsider it by replying to our answer. / **Deleting the account.** [unchanged] + When an operator's account is deleted, we also remove its customers' names, contact details and notes from the orders we keep. / **Marketing email.** We send marketing emails only when the law of the country you live in allows it, which in some countries means only with your consent. Each one states who it is from, our postal address and how to stop receiving them. If you ask us to stop, we will stop, free of charge and within 10 working days. Emails about an order or your account are not marketing. If we or a food truck offer order notifications by SMS, you will receive them only if you agree to it, and you can stop them at any time. / **If something goes wrong.** If a breach concerning your personal data is likely to cause you serious harm, we will inform you and the supervisory authority as soon as we can when the law requires it, or we will help the food truck you ordered from to do so. / **Complaints.** First contact us at privacy@hatchgrab.com; we would be grateful for the chance to put things right. You can also submit a complaint to the data protection authority in the country you live in. In the UK, that is the Information Commissioner's Office (Office of the Information Commissioner), at ico.org.uk or on telephone number 0303 123 1113.
back.G: Our [Terms of Use] apply in every country where HatchGrab is used. In some countries additional rules apply.
